defaultValue: Press Select on the watch, say a question, then confirm the transcript. The answer appears in large text. Time 2 and 2 Duo can also speak; other Pebbles show the same answer. Back always stops the current request or voice.

items.label: Service address
items.description: Use the HTTPS address provided with your installation token.

items.label: Installation token
items.description: Enter a Field Inspector installation token. It stays on the phone. Do not enter an OpenAI, ElevenLabs, or general gateway key.

items.label: Speak replies when available
items.description: Text always appears first. The watch’s mute and Quiet Time settings are respected.

items.defaultValue: On the watch, hold Down for Help. Select in Help runs an offline demo: a clearly labeled example answer and a short test tone. No question is sent to the service.
